policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Latvia's current MFA list identifies visa-free short visits for Latvian citizens to the five named destinations.
conditions: BW: up to 90 days in a year; DO: up to 30 days for tourism; PA: up to six months for tourism; TN: up to 90 days; UA: up to 90 days in 180 days.
This is limited to the stated short-visit purpose and duration, and excludes work, study, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: Syria electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Latvian MFA guidance says Latvian citizens may arrange Syria's entry visa electronically.
conditions: The current MFA guidance directs travellers to Syria's electronic visa service and separately warns that an Israeli border-crossing stamp can result in refusal.
This excludes work, residence, special documents, operational travel restrictions and final admission.

application.label: Syria electronic visa service
steps: Arrange the entry visa electronically before travel using an ordinary Latvian passport.

policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: Iraq arrival visa
policies.summary: Latvian citizen passport holders can obtain Iraq's entry visa at land, airport or port border points.
conditions: The stated border-issued visa is for up to 60 days, cannot be extended, and costs USD 75.
The guidance also applies to the Kurdistan region; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Latvian ordinary-passport visitors can arrange Jordan's entry visa at the border on arrival.
conditions: Jordan also offers an eVisa option before travel; the border-issued route controls this normalization.
This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.
